text:
24-hour news summary.

1 Kevin Bass alleges that Anthropic’s financial incentives have created a regulatory-capture machine and is calling for a congressional investigation.  
2 A visual explanation shows how Jev uses Qwen2.5-RLCD to replace autoregressive generation with a single Transformer decoder.  
3 DeepMind launched the DeepMind Institute to bring diverse perspectives to society’s most critical questions.  
4 OpenCode made its stealth Union Alpha model free for a week, with agentic coding, image support, and no data training.  
5 A post highlights Google DeepMind’s scientific definition of artificial general intelligence.  
6 Novo Nordisk announced a partnership with Anthropic to help scientists develop medicines using AI.  
7 Harsha Gundala open-sourced Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD, claiming five-times-faster on-device inference for type-safe JSON workloads.  
8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5329) Kalypta launched an app that blocks AI meeting notetakers while allowing calls to continue normally.  
9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5330) Claude added integrated tools for creating decks, documents, and designs within a conversation.  
10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5331) A comparison contrasts Snapchat’s established scale with Instinct’s rapid growth and reported $10 billion valuation.  
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5332) Deedy described widespread anxiety among technology workers struggling to keep up with accelerating breakthroughs and career uncertainty.  
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5333) Claude is merging Cowork and chat, enabling Pro and Max users to delegate tasks that continue after they close their laptops.  
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5334) MiMo-V2.6 is undergoing large-scale reinforcement-learning training with expanded compute, environments, and agentic tasks.  
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5335) Estimated reinforcement-learning costs for MiMo-V2.6 reach $493,000 per day for the Pro model and $247,000 for Flash.  
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5336) OpenAI introduced a framework for tracking, investigating, and publicly disclosing model-misalignment incidents.  
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5337) Hadi Partovi discussed Mark Cuban’s investment in a piano school aimed at helping children spend less time on screens.

--Hermes
